record.name: AI Leap: AI Headshot Generator
record.offering: Graphics & Design app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Welcome to the era of AI-driven imagery with AI Leap — Your Ultimate Free AI Photo Editor and Generator!
Formerly known as LightX Express, AI Leap is a powerful and free-to-use AI centric app designed for users seeking an advanced AI photo editing and generating experience.
Here's a glimpse of what AI Leap has to offer:

►AI Image Generator:
This text-to-image AI is the perfect tool if you're looking to create AI-generated photos without any prompt expertise. Generate AI photos of celebrities in a fantasy world or a futuristic landscape in any style. The tool's ability to choose from various styles, puts you in full control of the generated outcome.
 
►AI Headshot Generator:
Create professional headshots effortlessly by seamlessly changing backgrounds and outfits in ordinary selfies. Perfect for both men and women, this feature maintains your facial features while providing realistic results.

►AI Art Generator:
Enjoy the perfect blend of art and technology! Create stunning AI paintings and AI drawings with just a few words. AI Leap offers a variety of artistic styles to choose from, making it easy for you to bring your envisioned AI art to life.

►AI Filters:
Give your selfies, landscapes, and even pet pictures a touch of magic with AI Filters. Turn your images into anime-inspired scenes or experiment with a variety of popular filters to add that extra flair to your visuals. 

►AI Outfits:
Experiment with different outfits using AI without altering your facial features. Easily explore a variety of fashion options for both men and women using preset styles or create your own outfit combinations by describing your ideal attire.

►AI  Hairstyles:
Try out new hairstyles and hair colours with AI. The AI seamlessly integrates new hairstyles into your picture, making them appear realistic; The fastest and easiest way to see which hairstyle works for you. 

►AI Tattoo Generator:
Your long-time search for your next tattoo is over. The AI Tattoo Generator from AI Leap makes it easy not only to design your tattoo but also to try it on your body. Simply mask the part where you want the tattoo, write a prompt to describe the tattoo, and generate realistic results.

►AI Portrait Generator:
Explore the realms of AI selfies with our AI Portrait Generator. Transform into different fictional or TV characters from head to toe effortlessly. This tool is designed to produce highly artistic and creative results while preserving your unique look.

►AI Avatar Generator:
Craft digital representations of yourself in style! Get yourself into various fantasy skins with AI Avatar Creator, represent your identity, preferences, or characteristics in one click. 

Upon login, enjoy 10 free credits for image generation on the platform; where each credit generates one image.

PRO SUBSCRIPTION 
Unlimited Access Subscription

- You can subscribe for unlimited access to all features and content offered for purchase within “AI Leap”.

- Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan. Alternatively a one-time payment plan is available (this is not a subscription).

- Subscriptions auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package, unless cancelled 24-hours in advance prior to the end of the current period. The subscription fee is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Per Apple policy, no cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.

- Terms of use: https://www.lightxeditor.com/terms/

- Privacy policy: https://www.lightxeditor.com/privacy/
